main_measure.name: slope of 14-bar excess return on forecast (grid cases, forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with top third > 0), t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 14-bar return of the top third of forecasts

decided_by: Confirm rule: the slope's t is 2 or more and the top third's mean excess return is above 0.
reading: The profile is the regime 'unknown' and the rise a positive raw scaled return; the grid is bars 0, 14, 28, ... of each window with a full 14-bar return; the slope's t uses day-clustered standard errors (CR1); the top third is the ceil(n/3) largest forecasts, its t with deviations summed per day; the minimum of 30 cases is applied first as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: too few cases on the check folds (46 cases, 58 days)
